name: GCSE English Lit: Quillara
subtitle: GCSE English Literature prep
shortDescription: Revise GCSE English Literature: Shakespeare, novels, modern texts and poems with quizzes, quote labs and essay plans. Free to start, optional Quillara Plus.
longDescription:
Quillara is a revision companion for GCSE English Literature. Read concise lessons, test yourself with questions that explain every answer, and practise the skills examiners reward in interactive labs.

### What You Get
- 33 text lessons: seven Shakespeare plays, seven 19th-century novels, four modern texts and the fifteen poems of the AQA Power and Conflict cluster.
- 13 skills lessons on the assessment objectives, thesis and essay structure, extract questions, quotations, comparison, unseen poetry, verse and form, and exam craft.
- 537 original questions, each with a short explanation and a link back to the exact lesson part. Questions you miss return on a spaced schedule.
- Ten labs: Tension Arc, Character Web, Quote Lens, Essay Planner, Context Timeline, Terminology Trainer, Verse Meter, Paragraph Builder, Poem Compare Grid and an Unseen Poem Workbench.
- Two ways to learn: Syllabus order, or Real-World builds such as building a thesis or rescuing a weak paragraph.
- A curriculum map showing which board lists each text, and a Coverage screen that states exactly what is and is not included.
- Text size from 50 to 300 percent and layouts for phones and tablets.

### Honest Limits
Quillara is an independent app, not connected with or approved by AQA, Pearson Edexcel, OCR, WJEC Eduqas or any other body. It does not cover every set text of every board. Poems are covered one by one for the AQA Power and Conflict cluster only. For works still in copyright it uses original summaries and never reproduces their text. It cannot mark your writing. Check your own board's current texts and papers.
monetization: Free core course, optional monthly Plus
